messages:
Nadia: Quick sync  pulling together the exec compact for Northbridge ahead of Wed's EBR. Need: one-paragraph renewal status, exact exec asks (concise), slide owners, and action owners. Can we assign now?

Ben: Ill take onboarding status + rollout metrics. Will call out blocked pilots and add a 1-line quota ask.

Chloe: Ill write the renewal snapshot + mitigation owners. Plan to call out SSO, retention language, and quota friction. Posting draft tonight.

Tariq: Ill own the action tracker slide and enablement gaps. Will keep detailed timeline in the runbook; deck shows top 3 asks.

Marcel: Ill add the customer quote and short usage sparkline to openslide. Dropping assets into the shared deck now.

Nadia: Runbook link: https://redwood.app/s/nb-ebr-runbook-v1 (appendix slide 13). Final deck Tue 11am PT, dry run Tue 3:30pm PT, exec Wed 10:30am PT. If your slide isnt in by Tue 11am Ill reassign.

runbook-bot: Template v2 synced at 1807654400 -> /decks/templates/ebr-2025-compact-v2.

Ben: Onboarding note: 4 pilots; 2 paused due to region quota. Proposed exec ask (one-liner): "Authorize emergency region quota to unblock pilots (target: 48-72h)." Adding to my slide.

Chloe: Draft renewal snapshot: "Northbridge health: 69/100. Key risks: SSO integration lag affecting sign-on, ambiguous retention terms impacting compliance signoff, and region quota constraints slowing expansion. With targeted exec support on quota approvals and short-term SSO engineering, renewal likelihood improves materially. See mitigation asks below."

Tariq: Action items (deck summary):
- Chloe: mitigation paragraph + owner matrix (Mon EOD)
- Ben: onboarding slide + exact quota error text (Tue 9:30am)
- Tariq: action tracker + appendix pointer (Tue 10:45am)
- Marcel: testimonial + visuals (pushed)
- Nadia: update CRM stage & coordinate dry run (Tue)

Marcel: Short quote for main slide: "Integrations went smoothly; paused on region enablement." Full quote in appendix. Pushed assets.

Ben: infra error (copy for appendix):
```
error: region quota exceeded: requested 8 GPUs in us-west-2, available 0
component: infra/provisioner/alloc.go:214
```
Will confirm exact text with infra.

Chloe: Mitigation ask (compact exec bullets): 1) Prioritize SSO bugfixes (owner: Product Eng)  ask: ~2-3 weeks of focused bandwidth; 2) Publish retention SLA and legal sign-off (owner: CS/Product); 3) Expedite region quota approvals (owner: Sales Ops/Infra). Exec ask (one line): "Approve quota allocation and short-term eng bandwidth for SSO to remove major renewal blockers."

Ben: small wording tweak: change "~2-3 weeks" -> "~3 weeks" for clarity in exec slide.

Chloe: updated.

Nadia: CRM note: I will flip SFDC to "At Risk - Exec Assist" after Chloe posts final mitigation copy. Also will draft the short exec email that Sales Ops can attach to the quota request.

Tariq: Linking action tracker now. Appendix slide #14. Added ARR impact bullets for Sales Ops to use in request.

Marcel: Visuals look good; one ask: trim the sparkline colors to the exec palette.

Nadia: timeline reminder: Tue 11am final deck -> Tue 3:30pm dry run -> Wed 10:30am exec. If anything slips ping me here. Tagging: @Ben @Chloe @Tariq @Marcel. :raised_hands:

Ben: will drop final onboarding slide by Tue 9am.

Chloe: posting final mitigation paragraph here in 30m for quick review before I add to deck.

(5 reactions on Nadia's last message: :white_check_mark: :eyes: :rocket: :thumbsup: :calendar: )
